name: Craquelure
desc: An ageing surface tearing itself apart — crack tips run along the stress field, arrest dead against older cracks in perfect T-junctions and branch into ever-finer generations, while raking light sweeps their lifted edges and the oldest fractures sink slowly back under the varnish.

energy.doc: crack propagation rate and surface light contrast

density.doc: crack nucleation count and surface grime

speed.doc: rate multiplier on growth and process time
